scripts.text: The kind of items you have is too various. Retry after reducing the sort of items.
scripts.translation: 您携带的物品种类太多，请整理物品栏后再试。

scripts.text: You are overburdened, so you cannot proceed it anymore. Please try again after reduce the weight.
scripts.translation: 负重过高，无法继续操作，请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text:
[Billy The Golden Hands]
Huhu. Did you bring some coins? I would sell anything but my soul if you have coins.
scripts.translation:
[金手 比利]
呵呵。你带了硬币吗？只要你有硬币，除了灵魂之外，我什么都卖。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Closed Mind Box (100 Coins)
scripts.translation: 心门紧闭箱（100枚硬币）

scripts.text: Lush Rose (500 Coins)
scripts.translation: 新鲜玫瑰（500枚硬币）

scripts.text: C Lush Rose (1000 Coins)
scripts.translation: (时装)新鲜的玫瑰（1000枚硬币）

scripts.text: C Santa Hairband (500 Coins)
scripts.translation: (时装)圣诞老人玩偶发箍（500枚硬币）

scripts.text: C Red Bonnet (500 Coins)
scripts.translation: (时装)红色无边软帽（500枚硬币）

scripts.text: Old Parasol (1000 Coins)
scripts.translation: 老旧阳伞（1000枚硬币）

scripts.text: Hot Tea (7 Coins)
scripts.translation: 温暖红茶（7枚硬币）

scripts.text: Sweet Canape (5 Coins)
scripts.translation: 甜蜜饼干（5枚硬币）

scripts.text: Holy Water (1 Coin)
scripts.translation: 圣水（1枚硬币）

scripts.text: Water Of Darkness (1 Coin)
scripts.translation: 黑暗之水（1枚硬币）

scripts.text:
[Billy The Golden Hands]
Khaha, do you feel any scruples or something? Alright, then. Come again at anytime when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[金手 比利]
咔哈哈，有什么顾虑吗？
行吧，等你改变主意，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Billy The Golden Hands]
You need ^0000ff{0}^000000 Bloody Coins to buy ^0000ff{1}^000000. Are you going to buy it?
Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Purchase
scripts.translation: 购买

scripts.text:
[Billy The Golden Hands]
Khaha, what a fickle friend you are. If you really decide to buy it, come again.
scripts.translation:
[金手 比利]
咔哈哈，你还真善变。
决定要买了再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Billy The Golden Hands]
You have paid for it. I look forward to seeing you again.!
scripts.translation:
[金手 比利]
钱收到了，期待下次光临！

scripts.text: [Billy The Golden Hands]
scripts.translation: [金手 比利]

scripts.text:
[Billy The Golden Hands]
You need ^0000ff{0}^000000 Bloody Coins to buy ^0000ff{1}^000000. You are short of them.
scripts.translation:
[金手 比利]
需要^0000ff{0}^000000枚沾血硬币才能购买^0000ff{1}^000000。
你的硬币不够啊。

scripts.text: You need ^0000ff{0}^000000 Bloody Coins to buy ^0000ff{1}^000000. You are short of them.
The kind of items you have is too various. Retry after reducing the sort of items.
scripts.translation: 您携带的物品种类太多，请整理物品栏后再试。

scripts.text: You are overburdened, so you cannot proceed it anymore. Please try again after reduce the weight.
scripts.translation: 负重过高，无法继续操作，请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Oh, I'm sure that you came here because you don't like ordinaries. Just talk to me. I will make anything if you have prepared the reasonable charge and the proper materials.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
哦，来找我的人，想必都不喜欢平庸的东西。
尽管开口，只要报酬和材料合适，什么我都能做。

scripts.text: Nothing that I want.
scripts.translation: 我没有什么想要的

scripts.text: I want Celine's Ribbon.
scripts.translation: 我想要席琳的蝴蝶结

scripts.text: I'm seeking Noble Cross.
scripts.translation: 我在寻找荣耀十架

scripts.text: I'd like to get Evilspirit Gloves.
scripts.translation: 我想获得恶灵手套

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Yes, yes. Everyone says like you at first. See you later.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
好好好，大家一开始都这么说。
回头见。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Ho~ You are looking for a very unique headgear, my friend. You have great discernment.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
嚯~朋友，你想找的是独一无二的头饰啊。眼光真不错。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Ho~ You are looking for a very precious weapon, my friend. You have great discernment.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
嚯~朋友，你想找的是非常珍贵的武器啊。眼光真不错。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Ho~ You are looking for a very rare accessory, my friend. You have great discernment.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
嚯~朋友，你想找的是极其稀有的饰品啊。眼光真不错。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
I need ^0000ff1000 ^000000Bloody Coins and ^0000ff+9 or greater Lush Rose^000000 for ^0000ffCeline's Ribbon^000000. Do you have enough materials?
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
兑换^0000ff席琳的蝴蝶结^000000，需要^0000ff1000^000000枚沾血硬币和一朵^0000ff+9以上精炼的新鲜玫瑰^000000。材料够吗？

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
I need ^0000ff2000 ^000000Bloody Coins and one ^0000ffGrand Cross (slot)^000000 for ^0000ffNoble Cross^000000. Do you have enough materials?
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
兑换^0000ff荣耀十架^000000，需要^0000ff2000^000000枚沾血硬币和一把^0000ff圣锤 十字星（有孔）^000000。材料够吗？

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
I need ^0000ff1000 ^000000Bloody Coins, one ^0000ffHurt Mind, Kind Heart, and Red Lantern ^000000each for ^0000ffEvilspirit Gloves^000000. Do you have enough materials?
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
兑换^0000ff恶灵手套^000000，需要^0000ff1000^000000枚沾血硬币，以及^0000ff受伤的心、宅心仁厚和红色手提灯^000000各一件。材料够吗？

scripts.text: I don't have them now
scripts.translation: 我现在没有

scripts.text: I will trade it right away
scripts.translation: 马上兑换

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Come back when you are ready. Let me remind you of the materials.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
等你准备好了再来吧。让我提醒你一下需要的材料。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
You should prepare ^0000ff1000 ^000000Bloody Coins and one ^0000ff +9 or greater Lush Rose^000000 for ^0000ffCeline's Ribbon^000000. Don't forget!
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
记得准备^0000ff1000^000000枚沾血硬币和一朵^0000ff+9以上精炼的新鲜玫瑰^000000，才能兑换^0000ff席琳的蝴蝶结^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
You should prepare ^0000ff 2000 ^000000Bloody Coins and one ^0000ff Grand Cross (slot)^000000 for ^0000ffNoble Cross^000000. Don't forget!
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
记得准备^0000ff2000^000000枚沾血硬币和一把^0000ff圣锤 十字星（有孔）^000000，才能兑换^0000ff荣耀十架^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
You should prepare ^0000ff1000 ^000000Bloody Coins, one ^0000ffHurt Mind, Kind Heart, and Red Lantern ^000000each for ^0000ffEvilspirit Gloves^000000. Don't forget!
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
记得准备^0000ff1000^000000枚沾血硬币，以及^0000ff受伤的心、宅心仁厚和红色手提灯^000000各一件，才能兑换^0000ff恶灵手套^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Are you really going to trade them? ^ff0000The refine levels, effects, and card of the item will disappear and you cannot get a refund^000000. Please consider it!
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
你确定要兑换吗？^ff0000装备的精炼等级、效果和卡片都会消失，且无法退款^000000。请仔细考虑！

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Are you really going to trade them? ^ff0000The effects, and card of the item will disappear and you cannot get a refund^000000. Besides, if you have the same sort of things, I don't know which one will be chosen. Think about that.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
你确定要兑换吗？^ff0000装备的效果和卡片都会消失，且无法退款^000000。另外，如果你有多件相同物品，我也不知道会选中哪一件。想清楚再决定。

scripts.text: I will try it next time
scripts.translation: 我下次再来

scripts.text: Exchange them right away
scripts.translation: 马上兑换

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Okay, you are determined. Hope we can see each other next time, huhu.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
好，看来你已经下定决心了。
希望下次还能见面，呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
The hat you wear is not Lush Rose. Bring me the right material that I told you, kukuku.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
你戴的不是新鲜玫瑰。
把我说的材料带对了再来，嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
The hat you wear is not refined to +9 or greater. You cannot trade with that.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
你戴的帽子还没精炼到+9，不能用来兑换。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Well, you are short of Bloody Coins. You need to gather exactly 1000 of them. Less than that.. It can't be helped.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
嗯，沾血硬币不够。
要凑齐1000枚，少一枚都不行...我也没办法。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
The deal has completed. Take a look at it.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
交易完成，看看成品吧。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
The thing on your right hand is not Grand Cross (slot). Bring me the right thing I told you, kuku.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
你右手拿的不是圣锤 十字星（有孔）。
把我说的东西带对了再来，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
Well, you are short of Bloody Coins. You need to gather exactly 2000 of them. Less than that.. It can't be helped.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
嗯，沾血硬币不够。
要凑齐2000枚，少一枚都不行...我也没办法。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
The deal has completed. Take a look at it.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
交易完成，看看成品吧。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
You don't have enough materials.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
你的材料不够。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
The deal has completed. Take a look at it.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
交易完成，看看成品吧。

scripts.text:
[Vagrant Cain]
You should prepare ^0000ff1000 ^000000Bloody Coins, one ^0000ffHurt Mind, Kind Heart, and Red Lantern ^000000each for ^0000ffEvilspirit Gloves^000000.
scripts.translation:
[流浪者 凯恩]
准备好^0000ff1000^000000枚沾血硬币，以及^0000ff受伤的心、宅心仁厚和红色手提灯^000000各一个，就能兑换^0000ff恶灵手套^000000。

scripts.text: The kind of items you have is too various. Retry after reducing the sort of items.
scripts.translation: 您携带的物品种类太多，请整理物品栏后再试。

scripts.text: You are overburdened, so you cannot proceed it anymore. Please try again after reduce the weight.
scripts.translation: 负重过高，无法继续操作，请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Huhu, humanbeing's greed is naturally wantless. What do you want me to do?
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
呵呵，人类的贪欲真是永无止境。
想让我做什么？

scripts.text: What can you do for me?
scripts.translation: 你能帮我做什么？

scripts.text: Enchant accessory of Toy Factory
scripts.translation: 附魔玩具工厂的饰品

scripts.text: Enchant weapon of Toy Factory
scripts.translation: 附魔玩具工厂的武器

scripts.text: Enchant headgear of Toy Factory
scripts.translation: 附魔玩具工厂的头饰

scripts.text: Enchant footwear of Toy Factory
scripts.translation: 附魔玩具工厂的鞋子

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
What do I do? That's really simple. You just bring me Bloody Coins and I will get them and enchant your accessory.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
我能做什么？很简单。
带沾血硬币来，付给我，我就帮你给饰品附魔。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
I will take 15 Bloody Coins for each try. I will enchant one slot amount for every 15 Coins. Of course, 3 is the maximum.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
每次收15枚沾血硬币，附魔一个插槽，最多可以附魔三个插槽。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Well, it is so natural that the destruction rate will get higher as the upgrade level increases. I would recommend you to stop first or second try, tee-hee.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
附魔次数越多，装备损坏的风险自然越高。
我劝你附魔一两次就收手吧，嘻嘻。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Oh, you are equipped with ^0000ffNoble Cross^000000! This thing need to find someone else to enchant it.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
哦，你装备了^0000ff荣耀十架^000000！这东西需要找别人来附魔。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
I've tried several times, but have no luck.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
我试过几次，都没成功。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
If you want to enchant this weapon, find ^0000ffMayomayo^000000 in Malangdo island! He should be able to do it.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
如果你想附魔这把武器，去绵绵岛找^0000ff马约马约^000000！他应该能做到。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
You can choose one of 2 types and the fee for each try is 15 Bloody Coins.. I will get them right before enchanting it.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
你可以从两种类型中选择一种，每次尝试的费用是15枚沾血硬币。我会在附魔前收取它们。

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: A random stat one among STR/AGI/DEX
scripts.translation: 随机提升力量/敏捷/灵巧之一

scripts.text: A random stat among INT/VIT/DEX
scripts.translation: 随机提升智力/体力/灵巧之一

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Okay, let's try the first enchantment. Usually, they are not broken. About 95% success rate?
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
好，先来第一次附魔。
一般不会弄坏，成功率大概有95%吧？

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Ho~ Second enchantment. Now it became dangerous. The success rate is about 70%. Do you want continue? The whole accessory will be blown if fail.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
嚯~第二次附魔，这下开始有风险了。
成功率大约70%，要继续吗？
失败的话，整个饰品都会毁掉。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
This is the last enchantment. Will you keep going? At this time, ^ff0000the success rate is below 50%^000000. Of course, it would be great if it is successfull... Hmm, I will follow your descision, but keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
这是最后一次附魔，还要继续吗？
这次^ff0000成功率不到50%^000000。
成功当然很好...嗯，决定权在你，可得想清楚。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Okay, come again when you are willing to, kuku.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
好，想做了再来，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
This equipment is not from Toy Factory. I can handle the items from Toy Factory only.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
这件装备不是来自玩具工厂。我只能处理玩具工厂的物品。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Ho~ This has already reached the peak. It is impossible to higher enchant, so be content and use it well.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
嚯~已经附魔到顶了，没法再提升了。
知足吧，好好用。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
I enchant weapons only once. There's no failure, so you can just think of it as the bonus effect, tee-hee.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
武器只能附魔一次，但保证不会失败，就当是额外的好处吧，嘻嘻。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
This equipment is not from Toy Factory. I can handle the items from Toy Factory only.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
这件装备不是来自玩具工厂。我只能处理玩具工厂的物品。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
The second enchantment. I will buff one of the previous states. There also is no failure, so don't worry, kukuku
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
第二次附魔，我会提升一种属性。
这次也不会失败，别担心，嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Good. Let's start the first enchantment. I will add one of the special battle effects. Of course, you don't have to be afraid because there's no failure, kuku.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
好，先来第一次附魔。
我会添加一种特殊战斗效果，不会失败，放心吧，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
This equipment is not from Toy Factory. I can handle the items from Toy Factory only.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
这件装备不是来自玩具工厂。我只能处理玩具工厂的物品。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Ho~ This has already reached the peak. It is impossible to higher enchant, so be content and use it well.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
嚯~已经附魔到顶了，没法再提升了。
知足吧，好好用。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
I don't enchant this!
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
我不附魔这个！

scripts.text: I will com back later
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text: Please do it
scripts.translation: 请开始吧

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
You blow hot and cold, this fickle friend.!
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
你还真是反复无常啊，朋友！

scripts.text: [Black Beard Joe]
scripts.translation: [黑胡子 乔]

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Ouch! Poor you, the enchantment has failed and your gear is broken, Geez!
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
哎哟，真倒霉！附魔失败，装备也毁了，啧！

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
There is a problem, please come back again!
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
出了点问题，请重新来一次！

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
I don't know what this is, but I think this isn't thing I could handle.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
不知道这是什么，反正我好像处理不了。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Hmm.. By the way, you need to fill up Bloody Coins. You cannot even pay for the fee.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
嗯...你得再去攒些沾血硬币了，连费用都付不起啊。

scripts.text:
[Black Beard Joe]
Hmm.. It was successful. Take a look at it.
scripts.translation:
[黑胡子 乔]
嗯...成功了。看看吧。

scripts.text: There is a problem, please come back again!
scripts.translation: 出了点问题，请重新来一次！

scripts.text: I don't know what this is, but I think this isn't thing I could handle.
scripts.translation: 我不知道这是什么，不过这不是我能处理的东西。

scripts.text: Ouch! Poor you, the enchantment has failed and your gear is broken, Geez!
scripts.translation: 哎哟，真可怜！附魔失败，装备也毁了，啧！

scripts.text: Hmm.. It was successful. Take a look at it.
scripts.translation: 嗯...成功了。看看吧。

scripts.text: Hmm.. By the way, you need to fill up Bloody Coins. You cannot even pay for the fee.
scripts.translation: 嗯...对了，你得补足沾血硬币，连手续费都不够。
